en.title: Metro Boosts Accessibility for FIFA World Cup Fans Amid Global Disability Inclusion Push
en.summary: The Metro transit authority announced expanded accessibility services, including improved station access and assistance, to accommodate fans with disabilities during the FIFA World Cup. Additionally, Black Moshannon State Park introduced new accessible trails and facilities, while advocates highlighted ongoing barriers such as blind banking customers being forced to reveal PINs and criticized government inaction on railway accessibility demands.

highlights.title: Metro expands accessibility services for FIFA World Cup fans
Black Moshannon State Park adds new accessibility options for visitors - WTAJ
Blind banking customers forced to reveal PINs due to inaccessible infrastructure
Ministers criticized for ignoring accessibility demands in railways bill

zh-TW.title: 地鐵擴大世界盃無障礙服務 確保殘障球迷便利出行
zh-TW.summary: 地鐵宣布擴大無障礙服務，包括改善車站進入及提供協助，以方便殘障球迷在世界盃期間出行。此外，黑莫沙嫩州立公園新增無障礙步道與設施，同時倡議者指出盲人銀行客戶因設施無障礙被迫透露PIN，並批評政府忽視鐵路無障礙需求。

highlights.title: 地鐵擴大為世界盃球迷提供的無障礙服務
黑莫沙嫩州立公園新增無障礙設施以方便訪客 - WTAJ
盲人銀行客戶因設施無障礙被迫透露PIN
部長因忽視鐵路法案無障礙需求而遭批評
